CLARIFY is caused by SUBSTANTIVE defects -- does the order's premise hold in the real target context -- and that rate did not improve at all. Keel still refused to write a one-line check script on his own authority (WO-28 A1), still proved defects by execution rather than inference (running the real moduleClosure() rather than reading imports), and still returned CLARIFY four times in five.
